relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: He graduated with a master's degree in arts from Madras Christian College in 1908.

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: In 1909, Radhakrishnan took a position in the Department of Philosophy at the Madras Presidency College.

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: In 1918, he was appointed professor of philosophy in the University of Mysore.

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.role: King George V Chair of Mental and Moral Science
relations.evidence: Three years later, he was appointed to the most important philosophy chair in India, King George V Chair of Mental and Moral Science in the University of Calcutta (Kolkata).

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: In 1929, he took a post at Manchester College, Oxford

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.role: Spalding Professor of Eastern Religions and Ethics
relations.evidence: from 1936 to 1939 served as Spalding Professor of Eastern Religions and Ethics at Oxford.

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: From 1939 to 1948, he was the vice chancellor of Banaras Hindu University.

relations.subject: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
relations.evidence: He held the office of the chancellor at the University of Delhi from 1953 to 1962.
